rag.title: Agentic RAG
rag.alertLine1: Start with "Quick Presets" below, then fine-tune 1-2 core parameters.

presets.label: Quick Presets (Beginner Friendly)
presets.fastDescription: Faster response, lower cost, but may miss some edge information
presets.balancedDescription: Balance between speed and quality, suitable for most daily Q&A
presets.deepDescription: Broader retrieval, longer answers, but slower and more expensive
presets.matchedPreset: Matched current preset, you can continue fine-tuning core parameters

core.topKHint: Range {min}–{max}, recommended 6–12. Higher: more complete but slower; Lower: faster but may miss info.
core.minScoreHint: Range 0–1, recommended 0.30–0.45. Higher: stricter (more precise but may miss results); Lower: more lenient (more complete but noisier).
core.maxSplitQuestionsDesc: Complex questions are decomposed and retrieved separately
core.maxSplitQuestionsMeaning: Higher: broader coverage but slower; Lower: faster but may be incomplete
core.maxToolRoundsDesc: How many retrieval/expansion rounds per sub-question
core.maxToolRoundsMeaning: Higher: more evidence but slower; Lower: faster response
core.maxExpandCallsDesc: Additional retrieval attempts when initial retrieval is insufficient
core.maxExpandCallsMeaning: Higher: fewer missed answers but slower; Lower: saves time
core.retryOnFailureDesc: More stable against occasional network fluctuations
core.retryOnFailureHint: Recommended to enable. Disabling may affect answer completeness on occasional failures.
core.maxToolRetryDesc: Number of retries after a single failure
core.maxToolRetryMeaning: Higher: more stable but slower; Lower: faster
core.answerMaxTokensDesc: Limit final answer length (larger allows longer answers)
core.answerMaxTokensMeaning: Higher: more detailed but slower; Lower: shorter and faster

advanced.note: These parameters are for advanced tuning. If unsure, keep defaults. Record current values before modifying for easy rollback.
advanced.summaryTempMeaning: Higher: more divergent; Lower: more stable
advanced.queryTempMeaning: Higher: more flexible splitting; Lower: more conservative
advanced.answerTempMeaning: Higher: more creative style, but less stable
advanced.expandWindowMeaning: Higher: more complete recall, but may increase noise
advanced.expandTopKMinDesc: Minimum retrieval count for secondary expansion
advanced.seedSourceLimitDesc: Seed count for secondary expansion reference
advanced.finalizeMinSourcesDesc: Can converge early when reaching this source count
advanced.finalizeMinHighConfDesc: Can converge when high-score evidence reaches this count
advanced.evidenceMaxSourcesMeaning: Higher: more comprehensive; Lower: more concise
advanced.evidenceSnippetMaxCharsMeaning: Higher: more complete info, but longer prompts
advanced.sourceContentMaxCharsDesc: Max length of retrieval result content
advanced.sourceContentMaxCharsMeaning: Higher: more detail, but slower computation
advanced.promptNote: Modify prompts in small increments (within 10%), observe answer changes gradually.
